:::{#def-bfgs-update}
#### BFGS update (Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno)

Let $\matr{H}$ be a $p \times p$ [positive definite matrix](linear-algebra.qmd#def-positive-definite),
and let $\vecf{s}, \vy \in \reals^p$ satisfy $\dprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}} > 0$.
With $\rho \eqdef 1 / \dprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}}$,
the **BFGS update**
[@nocedal2006numerical, Chapter 6]
of $\matr{H}$ is

$$
\matr{H}^+
\eqdef \paren{\matr{I}_p - \rho \oprod{\vecf{s}}{\vy}}
\matr{H}
\paren{\matr{I}_p - \rho \oprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}}}
+ \rho \oprod{\vecf{s}}{\vecf{s}}.
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#rem-bfgs-curvature}
#### The curvature condition $\dprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}} > 0$

If the [strict inequality](algebra.qmd#def-strict-inequality) of @thm-convex-first-order holds for distinct points,
then $\dprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}} > 0$ whenever $\vx^+ \ne \vx$.
Add the versions at $(\vx^+, \vx)$ and at $(\vx, \vx^+)$:

$$
f(\vx^+) + f(\vx)
> f(\vx) + f(\vx^+)
+ \dprod{\deriv{\vx} f(\vx)}{\vecf{s}}
- \dprod{\deriv{\vx} f(\vx^+)}{\vecf{s}},
$$

so $0 > -\dprod{\vy}{\vecf{s}}$.
For a general $f$, a [line search](#def-line-search) that enforces a curvature condition on the [step length](#def-gradient-descent)
(the Wolfe conditions [@nocedal2006numerical, Chapter 3]) guarantees it.

:::
